- Pods are fully matured and brown/dried

- No visible fungal structures, lesions, or discoloration on pods or stems beyond normal maturity

This matches the symptom description exactly — "stems stay moist and green while pods mature normally." No other disease in the list produces this specific dissociation between stem senescence and pod maturation.
